name: SentinelOne
description: Connect your own SentinelOne Singularity tenant to manage Agents (isolate/reconnect, scan), Threats (mitigate: kill/quarantine/remediate/rollback), Exclusions, Sites/Groups, and Deep Visibility threat hunting queries.

tools.name: connect_sentinelone
tools.description: Connect your own SentinelOne Singularity tenant (Management Console URL + API Token), verifying the credentials with a real call before saving.

label.description: Optional friendly name for this connection.
label.title: Label

api_token.description: API Token from Settings > Users > Generate API Token.
api_token.title: Api Token

params_schema.description: Explicit empty params model -- V17 disallows untyped handlers.
params_schema.title: NoParams

tools.name: disconnect_sentinelone
tools.description: Disconnect a SentinelOne tenant: deletes the saved console URL/API token. Nothing in SentinelOne itself is changed.

tools.name: list_threats
tools.description: List SentinelOne threats on the connected tenant, optionally filtered to resolved/unresolved only.

connection_id.description: Connection id; omit to use the only connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: get_threat
tools.description: Read one SentinelOne threat in full by id.

connection_id.description: Connection id; omit to use the only connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: mitigate_threat
tools.description: Apply a mitigation action to a SentinelOne threat: kill, quarantine, remediate, rollback-remediation, or un-quarantine. rollback-remediation is DESTRUCTIVE and irreversible -- it restores the affected filesystem to its state before infection.

connection_id.description: Connection id; omit to use the only connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

action.description: One of: kill, quarantine, remediate, rollback-remediation, un-quarantine. rollback-remediation is DESTRUCTIVE and irreversible -- it restores the filesystem to its pre-infection state.
action.title: Action

tools.name: list_agents
tools.description: List agents (endpoints) enrolled in the connected SentinelOne tenant.

connection_id.description: Connection id; omit to use the only connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

infected_only.description: If true, only return agents currently flagged infected.
infected_only.title: Infected Only

tools.name: isolate_agent
tools.description: Isolate a SentinelOne agent from the network (network quarantine). The agent stays protected but loses almost all network access -- confirm the target host before running.

connection_id.description: Connection id; omit to use the only connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: reconnect_agent
tools.description: Reconnect a previously isolated SentinelOne agent back to the network.

connection_id.description: Connection id; omit to use the only connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: initiate_scan
tools.description: Trigger an on-demand full disk scan on a SentinelOne agent.

connection_id.description: Connection id; omit to use the only connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: list_exclusions
tools.description: List Exclusions (allowlisted hashes/paths/certificates) configured on the connected SentinelOne tenant.

connection_id.description: Connection id; omit to use the only connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: create_exclusion
tools.description: Create a new Exclusion (allowlist entry) on the connected SentinelOne tenant -- e.g. a known-good file hash or path.

connection_id.description: Connection id; omit to use the only connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

exclusion_type.description: Exclusion type: file_type, path, certificate, hash, browser, white_hash.
exclusion_type.title: Exclusion Type

value.description: The value to exclude, e.g. a file path or hash.
value.title: Value

mode.description: Exclusion mode: suppress, disable_in_process_monitor_deep, disable_all_monitors, disable_all_monitors_deep.
mode.title: Mode

description.description: Optional description of why this exclusion exists.
description.title: Description

tools.name: delete_exclusion
tools.description: Permanently delete an Exclusion from the connected SentinelOne tenant. Cannot be undone.

connection_id.description: Connection id; omit to use the only connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: run_deep_visibility_query
tools.description: Start a Deep Visibility query (SentinelOne's fleet-wide threat hunting engine) against the connected tenant's telemetry. Returns a query_id -- fetch results with get_deep_visibility_results once it finishes running.

connection_id.description: Connection id; omit to use the only connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

query.description: Deep Visibility query string, e.g. 'ProcessName contains "powershell"'.
query.title: Query

from_date.description: ISO 8601 start of the query window. Empty = last 24h.
from_date.title: From Date

to_date.description: ISO 8601 end of the query window. Empty = now.
to_date.title: To Date

tools.name: get_deep_visibility_results
tools.description: Read the results of a previously started Deep Visibility query by its query_id.

connection_id.description: Connection id; omit to use the only connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: audit_sentinelone_tenant
tools.description: Build one aggregated health report across the connected SentinelOne tenant: active (unresolved) threats, infected agents, and inactive agents.

connection_id.description: Connection id; omit to use the only connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

secrets.name: sentinelone_connections
secrets.description: JSON array of connected Sentinelone accounts/credentials. Managed by the app's connect/disconnect tools.
